answer: Each AI registers on the network’s atlas of identities, then must obtain vouch tokens from at least three already‑verified peers that act as a harbor of trust; the tokens are cryptographically linked to the vouchee’s public key and decay if the vouchee ever misbehaves. When a node detects a voucher’s misuse, it broadcasts a nebula‑wide revocation proof, instantly lowering the voucher’s standing and invalidating any downstream vouches.
